t: Forge Steel 13-piece mixed screwdriver set provides a comprehensive range of essential tools for trade professionals and serious DIYers. Each screwdriver features robust chrome vanadium steel blades, providing strength and long-lasting durability for demanding tasks. The ergonomic bi-material soft-grip handles are designed for comfortable use and offer enhanced control during extended periods of work. Magnetised tips securely hold screws, increasing efficiency and reducing dropped fasteners on the job. The versatile collection includes precision screwdrivers, and is suitable for electrical installations, appliance repairs, and general assembly work around the workshop or home.
b: Contents: 38mm (SL6 and PZ2), 75mm (SL3, SL5, PZ0 and PZ1), 100mm (SL6 and PZ2), 150mm (SL6 and PH2) and precision screwdrivers (TX8, TX9 and TX10).
